verdict.rationale: Viam's docs say operators can stream camera feeds in real time from the browser and drive bases with keyboard controls from the web interface. Built-in NAT traversal lets them connect to machines through firewalls with no VPN or port forwarding, which covers the core of remote teleoperation with live video. The evidence is vendor-only and says nothing about control latency or video performance on constrained or lossy networks. missing for 10: evidence of latency/responsiveness or video quality on low-bandwidth or lossy links, independent hands-on corroboration of teleop performance.
